mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, conditions are clear and 75 degrees over Badger Prairie County Park, with the Waning Crescent moon phase.

The City of Verona Common Council has adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote. This long-range strategy focuses on creating strong neighborhoods, supporting our local business environment, and ensuring sustainable infrastructure for the next decade.

There is plenty to do, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market today at Hometown Junction Park, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, check out the ART House 360 events and Hop Haus Trivia.

In a noteworthy call from September 28, a 16-year-old was cited for reckless driving and operating a motorcycle without a license following a collision at the intersection of Enterprise Drive and East Verona Avenue.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Turtle Cheesecake. The store is currently open and serving guests until 10:00 PM, so be sure to stop by soon.
